title: Traditional Egyptian Date Tagine
description: A classic North African dessert made with dates, nutmeg, and a hint of spice.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine dates, infused sugar, almond extract, and ground nutmeg.
Mix well until the dates are evenly coated with the sugar mixture.
Transfer the date mixture to a 9-inch (23cm) round baking dish.
Sprinkle the Egyptian tagine spice blend evenly over the top of the date mixture.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the filling is bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
